cues.text: Good evening.King's Restaurant.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Good evening.I'm ringing about the job I understand you have vacant.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh yes
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I'd like to find out a few more details,if i may.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes,of course.Can i take your name?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: It's Peter Chin.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Okay Peter.Well,if you want to ask about the job and then if we're both still interested, we could arrange for you to come for an interview.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Great,thanks.I'm afraid i missed the advert for the job but heard about it from a friend.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: That's no problem at all.What would you like to know?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Well,um,what sort of work is it - washing up?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: It's answering the phone.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh right,fine.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And not waiting at table.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That'd be good.And how many nights a week would it be?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well,we're really only busy at the weekend.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: So two nights?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Three actually,so it would work out at twelve hours a week.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That'd be fine.It wouldn't interfere with my studies.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Are you at the university?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes.First year Physics student.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: On.right.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Um,and because i'm not an EU national would i need a work permit?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes you would. Just get your tutor to sign it.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That wouldn't be a problem,if i were to get the job.Um,where exactly is the restaurant?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well,we have two branches - the one we're recruiting for is in Hillsdunne Road.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I don't know that.How do you spell it please?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: It's H-I-double L-S-D-U-double N-E Road.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Got that.Thanks.is it near a bus stop?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes. The nearest one would probably be just beside the Library.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh yes,i know it.That'd be fine for me.And could i ask about the pay?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: We're offering￡4.45 an hour.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That's very good.My last job was ￡3.95 an hour.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: We feel it's pretty good and we also offer some good fringe benefits.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Really?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well,we give you a free dinner,so you eat well.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Right,better than hostel food!
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: We certainly hope so! And we also offer extra pay for working on national holidays.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh,that's a really good perk,isn't it?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes,we think so.And then because of the difficulties of getting public transport, if you're working after 11 o'clock we drive you home.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh,that's good to know.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: well,we'd certainly be interested in inviting you for an interview,if you're still interested?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh yes,certainly.Could I just also ask what qualities you're looking for?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well,for this particular job we want a clear voice,which you obviously do have!
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Thank.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And you must be able to think quickly,you know.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Well,i hope i'd...
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: So,when could you come in for an interview?We're actually quite quiet tonight?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Sorry,I couldn't come tonight.Or tomorrow,I'm afraid.Thursday's okay that'd be 22nd of October.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Fine,after 5 p.m.?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes,fine.Would 6 o'clock be okay?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Perfect.And could you bring along the names of two referees?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes,that's fine,no problem.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Good,I look forward to seeing you.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh,by the way,who should i ask for?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh yes ,of course,sorry.My name is Samira Manuja.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Can you spell that,please?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: M-A-N-U-J-A.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Okay.i've got that.Thanks very much.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Look forward to seeing you...
cues.speaker: WOMAN
